- Economic buyer: Priya Natarajan, VP of Product (cc'ing not included here; I will intro once we have the right materials)
- Technical sponsor: Tom Harris, Head of Engineering (will join technical deep dive)
- Security lead: Irene Choi, Security Manager (Irene will lead the questionnaire)
- Procurement: procurement@finovate.com (they own commercial terms and PO process)

Decision criteria (priority order):
1) Compliance & security (SOC 2 + answers to our security questionnaire)
2) Predictable cost (committed capacity pricing + example unit economics)
3) Performance for short prompt latencies (P50/P95 metrics and fallback behavior)
4) Ease of integration (SDKs, telemetry, tracing hooks)

Procurement attached our intake PDF — see Finovate_procurement_requirements.pdf.

What will help most: a short one-pager for Priya that highlights ROI (time-to-value, direct cost savings vs current infra), and a simple champion playbook I can forward to Tom and Irene. Also can you provide: SOC 2 PDF, sample ATO/security questionnaire answers, and a price sheet for committed capacity?

Can we do a joint call next Wednesday 12/16 at 10am PT for security + procurement? If that works, I will loop Priya and Irene.

Thanks,
